name: Overhaul
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode only on merged PRs flagged as high-risk by a lightweig flagging system—this cuts noise by 70% while still measuring impact where it matters most. Pair this with a one-week pilot on a single team already using the lightweig flagging to validate the approach before scaling.

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on *merged* PRs only for two weeks. This keeps the signal clean—reviewers see real autofeedback only after the PR is locked, so they won’t ignore it later. The trade-off is we miss data on open PRs, but that noise isn’t worth the risk of training bad habits. If the merged PRs show clear value, we scale to open PRs; if not, we drop it.

name: Ratchet
text:
DECISION: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode *only on merged PRs* for two weeks, then compare review quality metrics (e.g., review depth, time-to-merge) against a control team not using it.

Result: Clear data on whether autofeedback improves post-merge review quality without training bad habits.

Owner: Sprocket.
